ns2:section.sectionText: Open to sophomores, juniors or seniors. Topic: "Race, Gender and Information Technology." Meets with LIS 390, INFO 390, and AFRO 398. This course critically examines the ways in which information technologies are both the source and consequence of race and gender relations. Will explore theories of race, gender and technology and apply these to case studies of information and communication technologies (ICTs). Particular attention will be given to globalization, privacy and surveillance, labor, and "digital enclosures." Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
